case: custom enum[] grid parser and keyed edit preserve labels and refuse invalid values safely
contract: The app grid parser keeps a custom enum-array cell as exact array text and the keyed update builder applies the schema-qualified enum[] cast.
A live keyed edit preserves literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, comma-containing labels and SQL NULL elements against native pg_typeof, array_dims, array_to_json and array_send oracles.
An invalid enum label is rejected without changing the edited row; the sibling row retains its exact array_send bytes.

native_array_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

app_parser_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --lib value_contract_postgres_custom_enum_array_grid_literal_stays_text_with_a_qualified_cast -- --nocapture

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-core -p tablepro-driver-postgres -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Installed grid interaction, other PostgreSQL array families and additional enum/session configurations remain open in B3.
